text:
Maria: Quick sync for IslandBridge private VPC handoff — network says routes live but we have 3 blockers: KMS key policy, IAM role mappings for the Redwood agent, and audit-log forwarding to their SIEM. Anyone free for a 10min?
Raj: I'm on. clarifying q: are they using host project Shared VPC or standalone? need project IDs and CIDR ranges.
Ellen: They're on Shared VPC (host-project: islandbridge-host). CIDRs: 10.4.0.0/16 for app, 10.5.0.0/16 for backend. I've pushed the route into their host, but firewall rules are pending -- see terraform snippet below.
Ellen: ```resource "google_compute_firewall" "redwood-allow" {
  name    = "redwood-allow"
  network = "projects/islandbridge-host/global/networks/shared-net"
  allow {
    protocol = "tcp"
    ports    = ["443","8721"]
  }
  source_ranges = ["10.4.0.0/16","10.5.0.0/16"]
}```
Maria: thx Ellen. Raj, on IAM: IslandBridge wants us to use their service account mapping instead of creating new SA. Sam, any objections from security?
Sam: OK with mapping if we get the exact IAM bindings and a short-lived impersonation flow for the agent. Also need to confirm KMS key policy allows Decrypt/Encrypt for the Redwood service principal. Can someone paste their policy example?
Raj: copying what they sent (sanitized):
Raj: ```{
  "bindings": [
    { "role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter", "members": ["serviceAccount:redwood-agent@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"] },
    { "role": "roles/owner", "members": ["user:island-admin@islandbridge.com"] }
  ]
}```
Sam: That looks fine but suggest limiting to a key ring principal and add a condition for environment==prod. I'll send suggested policy.
onboard-bot: Preflight scan complete: 11/14 checks passing. Failing checks: KMS policy missing condition, CloudTrail forwarding not enabled, IAM binding not pinned to SA. Run `./scripts/preflight --fix` to auto-generate PR for common fixes.
Maria: ops-sre, can you confirm CloudTrail / audit export path? IslandBridge wants logs in their splunk cluster; we'll forward via our log-shuttle.
ops-sre: Confirmed. We'll set up a sink to their logging project and use a push subscription. Config snippet:
ops-sre: ```gcloud logging sinks create redwood-audit-sink bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/islandbridge-logs/datasets/redwood_audit --log-filter="protoPayload.methodName:CreateBucket OR protoPayload.methodName:WriteLogEntries"```
ops-sre: After sink creation, they must grant writer to serviceAccount:logging-sink@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Ellen: Firewall rule deployed in staging. Will promote to prod after IAM/KMS handoff.
Maria: Risk note for CS: Renewal QBR in 6 weeks. IslandBridge flagged latency on cold starts during the POC — if onboarding drags, renewal sentiment could drop. Suggest offering a 30-day dedicated capacity trial (no commit) to show stable p99.
Raj: Agreed. I'll open a Renewal Risk ticket and cc AE + Customer Success Manager.
Sam: Also capture feedback: they asked for clearer KMS key rotation docs. I'll draft a one-pager for them and include rotation examples and sample IAM policies.
Maria: Action items: 1) Sam to share KMS policy + rotation doc (ETA 48h). 2) Raj to create renewal-risk ticket and schedule QBR reminder (ETA 24h). 3) Ellen to push IAM firewall after policy confirmed (ETA 72h). 4) ops-sre to configure audit sink and share sink-sa details (ETA 48h).
Ellen: ack :thumbsup:
Raj: created CS-5421 renewal-risk and assigned to @maria, linked onboarding ticket ONB-1287.
Maria: Thanks all. I'll follow up with IslandBridge PM after Sam's doc. If anyone needs me ping @Maria.
ops-sre: Posting final checklist to internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboard/islandbridge-private-handshake — will update after sink tested.
Maria: closing sync. Good progress. :raised_hands:
